1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nf6 3.Qe2 Nc6 4.d4.strategy: Offers the d-pawn to open the centre: after ...exd4 the knight cannot simply retake, since ...Nxd4 would win it. But the queen still blocks the f1-bishop and the e4 pawn is under attack, so White has little to show for the pawn.
1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nf6 3.Qe2 Nc6 4.d4.name: Petrov's Defence: Moody Gambit
